title: Contracts Desk Note: Converting a Homesite Reservation into a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
A Homesite Reservation converts when a Home Purchase Agreement is written on the same community and lot for the same buyer while the hold is current.

## Lot premium protection

The reserved lot premium is honored only when the purchase agreement is written within the class's lot premium protection days after the reservation date. Counting starts the day after the reservation date and the last counted day is included; after that, the lot premium on the current community price sheet applies. The reservation date relied on is the one on that reservation's record.

## Where the money held goes on conversion

| Money held on the reservation | On conversion |
|---|---|
| Reservation deposit | moves to the purchase agreement as earnest money where the class transfers the deposit as earnest money |
| Premium holding fee | moves as lot premium deposit where the class credits the premium holding fee toward the lot premium |
| Paid extension fees | move as lot premium deposit where the class credits extension fees; otherwise retained |
| Swap, reinstatement and returned-payment fees, card convenience fees | retained |

## Lot premium deposit on the purchase agreement

The purchase agreement then requires a non-refundable lot premium deposit of the class's lot premium deposit percent of the lot premium, rounded half up to the cent, toward which the moved premium holding fee and creditable extension fees count.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A lot premium of 30000.00 with a lot premium deposit percent of 50 gives a lot premium deposit of 15000.00. A moved premium holding fee of 1500.00 and a creditable extension fee of 500.00 count toward it, leaving 13000.00 of that deposit to be met.

## Protection boundary (hypothetical 21-day protection, reservation date 1 May)

| Purchase agreement written | Day count | Lot premium applied |
|---|---|---|
| 22 May | day 21, the last counted day | the reserved lot premium |
| 23 May | day 22 | the lot premium on the current community price sheet |
